patterns.entry_requirement: IELTS score of 5\.5 with no band score lower than 5; or an accepted international equivalence\.\s*(?:All applicants must:\s*be at least 16 years old at the time the programme commences\.?\s*)?((?!.{0,4}Time limit)(?:(?!\s*Intakes & Applications)(?:.|\n)){20,200})

config.notes: NorthTec (Tai Tokerau / Northland business division of Te Pukenga / NZIST); host www.northtec.ac.nz/programmes/; Webflow CMS page, server-rendered text with hidden tabs, no usable page JSON. Header: '* N Weeks|Years Campus Overview'. Dates & Bookings tab: 'Rolling Intake , <Month d, yyyy> – <Month d, yyyy>' per class (start date = intake month; the end date is not an intake). International Fees: '$X [(per academic year)] + CSSF levy ($2.50/credit) (YYYY)*' repeated for each year; read only for 2026 onward; '(18 Months)' totals not read. Site note: fees for programmes longer than one academic year are first-year fees; 19-week certificate amounts are half-year totals and must be excluded. IELTS is NOT read: every page carries two template IELTS lines (5.0 and 5.5) before the programme-specific one. Intakes are not split domestic/international. 5 Oct 15:22 checks: no exit-award wording. International fees are already per academic year (or first-year), so no fee_total. entry_requirement = the programme-specific block after the two template IELTS lines (5.0 and 5.5), for review only.
